verdict.rationale: Glama is an API-bearing platform, so an official SDK is a fair ask, but the evidence shows no official SDK package for any language. It shows only an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec advertised "for generating a client" and per-endpoint cURL/JavaScript/Python/PHP request samples. Those are developer building blocks for constructing a client, not a vendor-shipped SDK, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
